WORK EXPERIENCE
➢ Worked for IBM INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED as a software Test Engineer from - August 2022 to April 2025
➢ Worked as Software Test Engineer in Deloitte USI from - June 2025 – April 2026
PROJECT :1
Project Client Role Testing Process Environment
: One Report : Bank of Hawaii : Software Test Engineer : TOSCA Automation : C#.Net, SAP MM, FICO, SAP S/4 HANA.
Description:
One Report system is a comprehensive corporate and small business banking solution providing a single unified view of the corporate banking relationships across asset and liability products, limits, trade finance and cash management. Corporate customers of the bank gain the flexibility to view details of each account, capability to make Inter-bank and Intra-bank payments, access to trade finance information and transactions, and the ability to perform cash management activities. This also supports comprehensive authorization workflow, Transaction Limits, Electronic Invoice Presentment and Payment (EIPP) and Corporate Administration.
Responsibilities:
➢ Lead, Manage and Drive QA teams in Agile methodology ➢ Generated the Generic Test Scripts\Functions for re-using across the project ➢ Created Modules in TOSCA for different applications using XSCAN/TOSCA Wizard ➢ Development of Regression Suite on thin client/Thick client the test cases using TOSCA ➢ Test Automation of GUI&NON-UI Applications ➢ Development of Regression Suite on thin client/Thick client the test cases using TOSCA ➢ Monitoring of All Interfaces which are releated to SAP FI ➢ ➢ ➢ Asset Integration with GL Accounts, Creation of Asset Master and Sub Asset Master
IHC-SEPA Payments-Non SEPA Payments-Collection and Payment Involved in Analysis for TRM
➢ ➢ Created Automation test framework using TOSCA
Involved Automation Framework Concept of Data-Driven framework in TOSCA
PROJECT :2
Project Client Role Testing Process Environment
: DUR : Medco, U.S : Software Test Engineer : :
UFT Automation Java, Mainframes-Rumba, Windows XP.
Description:
Drug Utilization Review – It is an application where every claim passes through for review. DUR process determines whether or not a drug in a prescription meets specifications for use as detailed in rules. Rules (Provided by Clinical Rule Station) generally are of a clinical or financial basis. As a result of meeting a condition, a claim may be rejected or a warning produced or passed.
Responsibilities:
➢ Understand the User Stories ➢ Lead, Manage and Drive QA teams in Agile methodology ➢ Generated the Generic Test Scripts\Functions for re-using across the project ➢ Building Share Object Repository. ➢ Updating daily and Weekly Status on Jira ➢ Converting User Stories in to Automation Scripts. ➢ Participated in Peer-Reviews for Automation Scripts. ➢ Executing the Automation scripts using UFT for Regression Cycle
➢
Involved in creation of detailed test plans test cases and test scenarios for different application modules according to functional requirements and business specifications
➢ Attending Weekly Status calls and sending the status report to the Manager.
PROJECT :3
Project Client Role Testing Process
: Personal Umbrella : EXIDE : Test Engineer : Manual Testing
Description:
➢ Umbrella insurance is extra liability insurance. It is designed to help protect you from major claims and lawsuits and as
a result it helps protect your assets and your future. It does this in two ways:
➢ 1.Provides additional liability coverage above the limits of your homeowners, auto, and boat insurance policies. This
protection is designed to kick in when the liability on these other policies has been exhausted.
➢ 2.Provides coverage for claims that may be excluded by others.
Responsibilities:
During the initial Phase I was involved in understanding the Business Requirements and Use Cases. • Generating the Test cases from the Use Cases. • • Execution of test cases and defect reporting. • Prepared the test data for the manual test case execution. • Prioritized, evaluated, monitored defects and Analyzed Defect History. PROJECT : 4
Involved QA teams in Agile methodology in Product based company
Project Client Role Testing Process
: Canada Post : Innova Post : Test Engineer : UFT Testing /API testing/ Functional Testing
Description
Canada Post is Canada's primary Crown postal operator, serving over 16 million addresses nationwide. Innova Post served as the dedicated IT shared services provider delivering technology solutions to support postal operations. The project involved end-to-end quality assurance of EST Online and EST 2.0 — enterprise mailing platforms supporting domestic and international shipments for individual and business customers. The platforms handled various mailing types catering to a wide range of customer needs across the Canadian postal ecosystem.
Responsibilities:

Led a team of 3 offshore QA engineers and acted as the direct liaison between 6 offshore developers and the QA function, ensuring efficient communication of defects, test outcomes, and blockers.
Performed Regression, Sanity, Functional, and API Testing across EST Online and EST 2.0 using UFT, Katalon Studio,
•
Postman, Ready API. Logged and tracked all bugs and defects in JIRA with appropriate priority and severity tagging for timely resolution. Served as the primary QA resource for a major Java 8 to Java 11 Security upgrade, executing the full regression suite and reporting several critical production-impacting defects.
Played a key QA role in the De Minimis tariff change project, validating updated trade threshold calculations between USA and Canada.
Conducted monthly Blue/Green deployment landing tests in production and performed post-deployment validation to ensure all functionalities were working as expected.
• Attended daily Scrum stand-ups, participated in sprint planning, and provided weekly status reports to the QA lead
and project manager.
